delivery.title: Delivery Delivery - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: A "Pass" pano zvinongoreva kuti sevha inotangwa yakadzosa HTTP 2xx chimiro - haitsigire iyo yekugamuchira sisitimu yakachengetwa kana kugadzirisa inotungamira. Tarisa mutumbi wemhinduro uri pamusoro kuti uone zvawataura; kana isina chinhu kana kungobvuma, iyo system inogona kunge iri kugamuchira chikumbiro asi ichiramba kana kuregeredza iyo payload mukati (yakaipa mazita emumunda mazita / mafomati ayo API , inodiwa munda parutivi rwayo iyo mubhadharo uyu usingabatanidzi, nezvimwewo).

push.title: Inobuda Webhooks - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Inonyatso gadzirisika webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), kana kuti yako Custom body template ine <fieldkey></fieldkey> zvibatiso (eg <example></example> ) - inoshanda sekuzadza cURL command kamwe.
push.curlHelp: Namata muenzaniso kukumbira yavo API zvinyorwa kana Postman inokupa (ine chaiyo kana sampuli data). Iyo URL , nzira uye misoro inoteedzerwa se-iri, uye kiyi yega yega mumuviri yakanyorwa pazasi saka iwe unogona kusarudza iyo CRM munda inozadza iyo kune yega yega inotungamira.
push.curlPrompt: Une cURL yemutengi here? <action>Ngenisa kubva cURL</action> kuzadza izvi uye mepu minda otomatiki.
push.urlVariables: Iyo URL inogona kuve nezvinosiyana zvakare, eg <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Misoro inofanirwa kuve iripo JSON , semuenzaniso {{example}}
push.modeSame: Tumira chiitiko chese kune imwechete URL
push.modeCreateUpdate: Gadzira rekodhi kamwe chete, wobva wavandudza rekodhi imwe chete (hapana zvakadzokororwa padivi pavo)
push.responseIdHint: Iko iyo ID iri JSON yavo pindura kuchikumbiro chekugadzira. Yakachengetedzwa pane inotungamira se <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Pakupera kwenguva, HTTP 429 uye 5xx zvikanganiso - mushure me1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: Maitiro anozadzwa sei mukati: iyi webhook inoshandiswa zvakare kune yega yega inotungamira - Leadrat haitumire muenzaniso wakamira, inotumira kusundidzira kutsva pese panoitika chiitiko chakasarudzwa, neIYO inotungamira kukosha kwazvino.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Fomu rinosanganisira yega yega nzvimbo inotungamira - hapana chekumisikidza.
push.howFilledCustom: Tsika - nyora chako chikumbiro muviri uye udonhe mu chero kupi; imwe neimwe inochinjirwa kukosha chaiko kweiyo lead isati yatumira. Dzvanya shanduko iri pazasi kuti uiise.
push.rawTemplate: Body Template (raw) - gadzirisa zvakananga kana kuisa zvinoshanduka
push.previewEmpty: (nyora muviri template pamusoro kuti uone preview)
push.resyncTruncated_one: Resync yakasundira yekutanga {{total}} ye {{count}} lead (muganho {{limit}} pakumhanya). Nakisa zuva renji kuti usundire mamwe.
push.resyncTruncated_other: Resync yakasundira yekutanga {{total}} ye {{count}} inotungamira (muganho {{limit}} pakumhanya). Nakisa zuva renji kuti usundire mamwe.
push.syncHelp: Sunda kutungamira kwese kwakanyoreswa mune ino zuva renji zvakare (siya ese ari maviri asina chinhu kusundira zvese).

receive.title: Gamuchira - Gamuchira Inotungamira mune Chero Fomati
receive.intro: Imwe neimwe sosi inowana yayo URL . Nongedza Facebook inotungamira ads, Zapier , fomu rewebhusaiti kana imwe CRM 's webhook pairi - vanotumira inotungamira mune yavo JSON kana fomu fomati, uye iwe unoisa minda yavo kune yako.
receive.urlIntro: Yako yekugamuchira URL - ipa iyi kune yekutumira sisitimu ( POST , JSON kana fomu-yakaiswa):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Gadzira URL itsva ? Iyo yekare inomira kushanda pakarepo.
receive.sendExample: Tumira muenzaniso mumwechete kutanga - unotorwa semuenzaniso (hapana chinotengeswa kunze kwenyika kudzamara mepu iri pazasi yachengetwa).
receive.securityAuthTitle: Gamuchira chete zvikumbiro zvakasainwa nechakavanzika ichi
receive.sampleLabel: Muenzaniso payload (namira imwe, kana kusiya isina chinhu kushandisa chikumbiro chekupedzisira chakagamuchirwa)

pull.title: Dhonza - Tora Inotungamira kubva kune Chero API
pull.intro: Leadrat inodaidza imwe system's API pane hurongwa (chero auth, chero paging) uye inopinza marekodhi ayo anodzosera. Marekodhi aakaona asati avandudza kutungamira kwakafanana.
pull.variables: Zvinosiyana-siyana: <since></since> (kumhanya kwekupedzisira, ISO nguva; bvisa kekutanga), <others></others>
pull.sampleHelp: Sevha, wobva watora sampuli - Leadrat inodaidza iyo API kamwe (peji rekutanga chete) uye hapana chainopinza kunze kwenyika.

inbound.title: Received Records
inbound.help: Rekodhi yese yakapinda uye zvakaitika kwairi.

api.title: Yako API - Mbiri-Nzira Kuwana kune Chero System
api.intro: Chero sisitimu ine kiyi yako API inogona kugadzira, kuverenga uye kugadzirisa zvinotungamira uye kunyorera kutungamira zviitiko. Tumira kiyi mumusoro we <hdr></hdr> , se <bearer></bearer> , kana (kana mudziyo usingakwanise kuseta misoro) se <query></query> . Limit: {{limit}} zvikumbiro paminiti.
api.noPermission: Chete munhu ane mvumo yeManage Settings anogona kuona kiyi API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa kiyi iyi woichengeta pane imwe nzvimbo yakachengeteka - kuitira kuchengetedza inongoratidzwa kamwe chete. Kana yarasika, gadzira imwe itsva.
api.regenerateConfirm: Kugadzira kiyi itsva API ? Ikozvino kiyi inomira kushanda nekukurumidza kune yega yega system inoishandisa.
api.openApiHint: Ngenisa iyo OpenAPI spec Postman , Zapier , Gadzira kana n8n kuti magumo ese agadzirire kushandisa.
